{{Quote|Y'know&hellip;I got only one regret about the bounty hunters finally catching ol' Han an' takin' 'im outta circulation.''"<br />"''That they didn't kill him?|The skull-faced pirate makes a joke about [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] plight|<ref name="SW79">[[Star Wars (1977) 79|''Star Wars'' (1977) 79]]</ref>}}
This '''skull-faced pirate''' was a member of [[Lemo and Sanda's gang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Arcan IV]]. He was present in the [[Lemo and Sanda's den|gang's base]] during the arrival of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], under the guise of "[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barpotomous Drebble/Legends|Barpotomous Drebble]]." The pirate backed up his bosses, [[Lemo]] and [[Sanda]] as they confronted "Drebble" and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. After Calrissian was able to kill [[Koruu]] using a [[Knife/Legends|knife]], the gang invited the "Captain" to dinner. The skull-faced pirate came with the gang to the restaurant where they discovered "Drebble's" true identity. The gang pulled their blasters on Calrissian, but he was able to escape with help from Chewbacca.
